description: Bus turistici - Fermate is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Toscana. Il dataset contiene le informazioni relative alle fermate dei bus turistici in occasione dei Mondiali di Ciclismo 2013. Coverage: Regione Toscana. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Toscana. Its tags are ciclismo, comune-firenze, eu, mondiale, mondiali. It offers 2 resource(s) in KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-05-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
